name: Kross Limited
summary: Kross Limited engages in the manufacture and supply of trailer axles, suspension, and automotive components in India and internationally. It offers trailer axles and suspensions; tractor components, including axle shafts, PTO and hydraulic lift shafts, planetary ring gears, differential bevel gears, control spring assemblies, spindle front axle and hydraulic parts, differential spiders, and pin front axles; truck components for transmission, rear axle assembly, and chassis parts, consisting coupling flanges, reverse forks, housing blocks, levers, and planet carrier housing, real axle shafts, pole wheels, spindles, inter axle assembly, gear joint assembles and steering UJs, bell crank levers,…
